title: Macro Deck Gauges widget data (v1)
description: Describes the JSON stored in WidgetEntity.Data for a Gauges widget (WidgetType.Gauges).
$comment: No top-level 'required' and additionalProperties left unset on every object, for the same reasons as the other widget schemas: a fresh widget's data is near-empty, and older or newer clients may write keys this schema does not know. 'gauges' has no maxItems: the widget draws the first eight gauges.

style.description: How every gauge is drawn: a full ring from twelve o'clock (default) or a three-quarter arc open at the bottom.

gauges.description: The gauges, in display order. Only the first eight are drawn.

backgroundColor.description: Widget background color, as #rrggbb or transparent. Absent or null keeps the widget's default background; transparent also removes the deck's tile behind the widget.

border.description: Outline drawn along the widget edge.

flows.description: Press-trigger action flows, stored the same way as an Action Button's. Stored on the wire as a nested JSON string; the editor may show it inlined as an array. Both forms are accepted here.

id.description: Stable identity of the gauge within the widget. Assigned when absent.

variable.description: Numeric variable the gauge shows, e.g. 'system_cpu_usage_percent'.

name.description: Optional name drawn below the value.

icon.description: An icon reference, as stored by Action Buttons: { type, reference }, for example an icon of the read-only Included pack. Drawn inside the ring.

min.description: Value at an empty ring. Absent means 0.

max.description: Value at a full ring. Absent, 0 or not above 'min' means automatic: the variable's own maximum when it declares one above 'min', otherwise min + 100.

color.description: Ring color as #rrggbb; the accent color when absent or null.

iconColor.description: Color of the icon inside the ring as #rrggbb, drawn as a silhouette. The icon's own colors when absent or null.

warnWhen.description: When the ring turns the warning color: at or above, or at or below, 'warnAt'. Absent or null means never.

warnAt.description: Warning threshold, in the variable's own units.

widgetBorder.description: Outline drawn along the inner edge of the widget.

style.description: Visual style; absent, null or 'off' means no border. The color-tinted styles are static, heartbeat, breathing, blink, comet and ants; hue-shift and rgb ignore color.

color.description: Ring color for the color-tinted styles. Falls back to a default color when absent or null; ignored by hue-shift and rgb.

actionFlow.description: One action-flow entry (a trigger and its action blocks). Its internal structure is deliberately not validated here - deep flow validation is out of scope for this schema.
